notes: Spec asserts: state stays ready during /usage and /status (both genuinely local -- see parser.go's payloadTypeCommandInvoked -> Skip=true, "Bookkeeping, not a turn boundary", live-confirmed in two real sessions where command.invoked is the session's last line with nothing following). Unlike claudecode/antigravity, muse needs NO warm-up turn first -- session.jsonl materializes at session-open (2-1_basic-turn sibling cell), so slash_window anchors directly off session_birth. command.invoked never reaches events.jsonl (Skip=true), so this spec can only assert the ABSENCE of a working/waiting transition during the window, not the PRESENCE of the slash invocation itself -- record's verify step separately greps the raw transcript.jsonl for the two command.invoked records as the positive check (see metadata.json caveats). RECORD-TIME CORRECTION: live recording (session 01a0a170-213a-72a3-a814-27fec488b3f5, 2026-09-14 21:41) confirmed session_birth/slash_window/turn_start/turn_end exactly as assessed -- /usage and /status both landed as command.invoked with no state transition, then the trailing prompt drove one clean ready->working->ready arc with zero tool calls. The teardown/process_exited phase is DROPPED: this recording reproduced ingo-eichhorst/Irrlicht#1962 (processlifecycle's watched map[int]string is last-write-wins per PID) -- the sole process_exited event landed on a goal-reminder subagent session (469dde44-2a9a-45a8-be02-013b429e01b0, parent_linked to the real session at 21:41:26.9) rather than the parent, matching the precedent already applied in 2-13_turn-end-terminal-text and 2-16_oversized-transcript-line. Separately, the driver's step_send counts /usage and /status toward EXPECTED_TURNS even though neither opens a real turn, so wait_turn reported driver_exit_reason=timeout despite the recording completing cleanly (exit_clean's process_exited event exists, just misattributed per #1962) -- same turn-accounting defect already documented in the 2-15/mid-turn-message-queued commits, out of scope to fix in this record pass.
